body.name: \Delta_n
body.def: For \(t\in[0,1]^2\), \(\Delta_n(t)=2\{\ell_n(\widehat\zeta_n)-\sup_{q:\,t\in\mathcal T(q)}\ell_n(q)\}\), with \(\mathcal T=\mathcal T_A\) in design A and \(\mathcal T=\mathcal T_B\) in design B; \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{rep}}(t)\) is the same statistic recomputed on an independent multinomial replicate under \(q\).
body.role: likelihood discrepancy for a candidate PN/PS value
